title: Emergency Pause Feature: Admin Feedback Survey

questions.text: What is your role with CarbonLedger?

options.admin: Contract admin (holds or co-holds an admin key)

questions.text: How many times have you paused or unpaused a contract (any network) in the last 6 months?
Have you completed the testnet practice exercise in the admin training guide?
I understand which operations are blocked when each contract is paused.
Choosing the pause end time (until_timestamp) is straightforward.
The 72-hour maximum pause window is appropriate.
I can quickly and confidently tell whether a contract is currently paused.
When a pause-related call failed, the error made it clear what went wrong.
Having separate pause switches for the credit and marketplace contracts is the right design.
In your most recent pause (real or practice), how long did it take from deciding to pause to the pause being confirmed on-chain?
The pause gave (or would give) me enough control to contain an incident.
Which limitations have affected you or worry you? (select all that apply)

options.upgrade_blocked: Contract upgrades are blocked while paused
options.admin_setters_blocked: Fees, treasury and project suspension can't be changed while the marketplace is paused
options.no_status_query: No simple way to check whether a contract is paused
options.no_reason: The reason for a pause isn't recorded anywhere
options.cross_contract_errors: Pausing only the credit contract makes purchases fail with confusing errors
options.single_marketplace_admin: The marketplace has a single admin key (no multi-sig)
options.window_too_short: 72 hours is too short for some investigations
options.user_messaging: Users only see raw error codes (#27 / #29)

questions.text: Has a pause ever ended (expired) before you expected it to?
How would you prefer to pause and unpause?

options.dashboard: A button in the admin dashboard

questions.text: The documentation and training prepared me to use the pause correctly.
How likely are you to recommend the current pause process to another admin? (0 = not at all, 10 = extremely likely)
What was the most confusing or stressful part of using (or learning) the pause?
If you could change one thing about the pause feature, what would it be?

recommendation_rules.question: q7
recommendation_rules.recommendation: Add read-only `is_paused()` / `paused_until()` views to both contracts and show pause status in the admin dashboard, so admins don't have to rely on simulated calls.

recommendation_rules.question: q12
recommendation_rules.recommendation: Add read-only `is_paused()` / `paused_until()` views to both contracts and show pause status in the admin dashboard, so admins don't have to rely on simulated calls.

recommendation_rules.question: q8
recommendation_rules.recommendation: Map EmergencyPaused (#27 / #29) and InvalidPauseWindow (#26 / #28) to plain-language messages in frontend/lib/carbon-error-codes.ts, and show a site-wide banner while a contract is paused.

recommendation_rules.question: q12
recommendation_rules.recommendation: Map EmergencyPaused (#27 / #29) and InvalidPauseWindow (#26 / #28) to plain-language messages in frontend/lib/carbon-error-codes.ts, and show a site-wide banner while a contract is paused.

recommendation_rules.question: q12
recommendation_rules.recommendation: Make marketplace purchases check the credit contract's pause state first (or offer a single 'pause both' action) so a credit-only pause returns a clear error instead of an aborted cross-contract call.

recommendation_rules.question: q12
recommendation_rules.recommendation: Allow `upgrade_contract` while paused (admin-only, already auth-gated), so a patched Wasm can be deployed without first reopening the contract.

recommendation_rules.question: q12
recommendation_rules.recommendation: Exempt admin configuration calls (fees, treasury, project suspension) from the pause check; the pause is meant to stop user value movement, not incident response.

recommendation_rules.question: q12
recommendation_rules.recommendation: Record a reason for each pause, either as a contract argument/event or through the backend pause analytics (#1324).

recommendation_rules.question: q12
recommendation_rules.recommendation: Move pause/unpause authority to a multi-signature or role-based model on the marketplace (see the 2-of-3 multi-sig proposal in docs/ISSUES.md).

recommendation_rules.question: q6
recommendation_rules.recommendation: Revisit the 72-hour maximum: check which way respondents disagree (q12 'window_too_short' and the open answers) before changing it.

recommendation_rules.question: q12
recommendation_rules.recommendation: Consider a longer maximum window that requires multi-admin approval, keeping 72 h for single-admin pauses.

recommendation_rules.question: q13
recommendation_rules.recommendation: Alert admins before a pause expires (e.g. 1 h and 15 min before `until_timestamp`), and show the expiry time wherever pause status is shown.

recommendation_rules.question: q5
recommendation_rules.recommendation: Replace raw `until_timestamp` entry with duration presets (1 h / 4 h / 24 h / 71 h) in admin tooling, with the resulting UTC time shown for confirmation.

recommendation_rules.question: q4
recommendation_rules.recommendation: Surface the blocked-operations table in the admin UI next to the pause controls, and emphasise it in training.

recommendation_rules.question: q15
recommendation_rules.recommendation: Make the testnet practice exercise mandatory before on-call rotation, and record the admin video tutorial.

recommendation_rules.question: q3
recommendation_rules.recommendation: Link the pause training from the on-call onboarding checklist and the runbook index.

recommendation_rules.question: q14
recommendation_rules.recommendation: Add pause/unpause controls (with confirmation and duration presets) to the admin dashboard.

recommendation_rules.question: q16
recommendation_rules.recommendation: Net promoter score is negative: review the open answers (q17, q18) with admins in a follow-up session before planning changes.
